item.title: libp2p activation and bootstrap repair
item.body:
Move the node's transport to libp2p for discovery and NAT traversal, and make a fresh node
able to join when the shipped seeders are dead (roadmap M3).

- Mixed-version, partition and eclipse tests, two months of soak on the public testnet
- Fix the bootstrap deadlock and the peer-DB issues filed against the libp2p backend
- Rebuild `DefaultSeeders` from nodes that answer
item.author: dev-ada
